validation.attribution: AI development ratings; these are not human review.
validation.limitation: Structural validation does not establish reviewer identity, source authenticity or semantic correctness.

analysis_contract.primary_relevance: same_issue means issue_relevance=2; any_relevance means 1 or 2
analysis_contract.top_k: At least one positive candidate among ranks 1..k, separately for each reply view
analysis_contract.absence: No retrieved hit, not a negative content rating; available-only rates also reported
analysis_contract.uncertain: Reported separately in rating counts; never counted as a positive yes
analysis_contract.inference_unit: Selected customer message; never the 360 rows or 244 reviewed contexts
analysis_contract.arm_pairing: All arms paired on the same selected messages, including absent slots as no hit
analysis_contract.reply_pairing: Only same message/thread with both views available; deduplicated across arms in union
analysis_contract.interval: Descriptive paired message-cluster percentile bootstrap; not confirmatory or multiplicity-adjusted
analysis_contract.input_hashing: cadence.eval.provenance.sha256 normalizes CRLF text; original packet raw-byte seals validate independently
analysis_contract.later_view_limit: Later views include preceding turns (often the first reply), so differences cannot isolate the later reply
analysis_contract.authority: Historical support is never combined with current-authority ratings
analysis_contract.review_limit: AI-only development judgments; no human validation, independent outcome observation, or promotion
